# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Lone Star Plumbing Co.
A modern plumbing business rooted in Texas identity, combining a trustworthy local feel with a bold, action-driven design. The brand emphasizes reliability and urgency — especially for emergency plumbing situations — while projecting a strong sense of community and regional pride. The website should make visitors feel they're dealing with a dependable, hometown expert who shows up fast when it matters most.
